data.long_meaning: The name Jannaat is derived from the Arabic word 'Jannah', meaning 'garden' or 'paradise'. In Islamic tradition, Jannaat refers to the beautiful gardens of Paradise, where the righteous will reside after death. The name Jannaat carries the meaning “Gardens of Paradise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jannaat usually hope their child will grow to embody gardens of paradise and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jannaat total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
